style.vernacular: A city of hills (originally seven, now nineteen) and wadis on a plateau at 700-1,100 m, built in cream and pale-yellow local limestone: stepped 3-6 storey apartment blocks and villas with stone-clad facades, flat concrete roofs carrying water tanks and solar heaters, arched windows and balconies, with older Ottoman and Circassian stone houses, Roman ruins on the citadel and downtown, and glass towers in Abdali and Abdoun. Pale dust-coloured palette, cypress, pine and olive trees.
style.ornament: Arched and round-headed windows and stone arcades; ablaq-style bands and carved cream stone cornices; blue-tiled mosque domes with slim pencil minarets; Roman columns and theatre stonework downtown; Umayyad carved stone friezes; water tanks and satellite dishes on every flat roof.

sources.what: East Bank Plateau, three major wadis, originally seven hills now nineteen, elevation 700-1,100 m; Roman theatre (2nd century AD) and Hashemite Plaza
